android.desc:
Chat with anyone in their language. Swift Translate is a chat translator for WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, Messenger and every app you chat in: drag the bubble onto a message to read it in your language, then type your reply and send it in theirs. Translate to English or any of 116 languages instantly, with no copying or switching apps.

WHATSAPP TRANSLATOR
• Translate WhatsApp messages without leaving the chat: open a WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business conversation and tap the chat icon. The conversation appears translated, and new messages translate as they arrive.
• Give each contact their own language. Switch on Auto and their chat translates automatically whenever you open it.
• Type your reply in your language and it's sent in theirs, with a quick check of what it says.
• Instagram DMs work the same way (turn it on in Settings).

MESSAGE TRANSLATOR FOR ALL YOUR CHAT APPS
• Telegram, Messenger, Snapchat, Discord, text messages and AI chats like Character AI and Chai: drag the bubble onto any message to read it in your language.
• Reply in their language anywhere: type your message, drag the bubble onto it, check the preview and send.
• The language is detected automatically, and every chat follows the pair you pick.

SCREEN TRANSLATOR
The same floating bubble translates everything else on your screen, even text you can't copy: posts, TikTok and Instagram comments, websites and menus in any app. The translation appears right next to the text. On Android 11 and newer, a subtitle box translates a video's captions as they change.

GAME TRANSLATOR
Play games in any language. On Android 11 and newer, drag the bubble onto a game's menus, quests or chat in RPGs, MMOs and visual novels. Great for Japanese, Chinese and Korean games, manga, webtoons and comics.

CAMERA AND IMAGE TRANSLATOR
• Point your camera at signs, menus, documents and books to translate them.
• Translate the whole screen in one go from the bubble menu.
• Drag the bubble onto text inside images to translate it.
Image, game and subtitle translation need Android 11+ and aren't on some lower-memory phones. Camera translation opens your phone's camera translator.

VOICE AND TEXT
• Speak in your language and get the translation, and hear how it's pronounced.
• Type or paste text, listen to it and find it again in your history.
• Offline mode: download language packs and translate without internet.
